title: 第15章 陆玄闪亮登场第16章 姬扶摇一招秒
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: 接下来。
众多玄皇境天才在火渊秘境第一层乱杀火兽！
围观的内门弟子无比震惊。
平日里强大的火兽竟然变得弱小不堪。
一天时间，有人爆杀三万多只火兽！
众多天才弟子都杀疯了！
杀得第一层火兽都来不及凝形出现了。
火渊意志及时出现制止，“火兽消耗太多，第一层火渊，三日内不再产生新的火兽！”
众多弟子震惊不已。
在姬扶摇师妹的刺激下，众多天才都变得这么彻底疯狂！
乱杀！
而此时，方岩，洛凌空和柳萱等顶级真传弟子则是踏入了火渊第二层！
开始破姬扶摇的纪录！
第二层入口处的镇关火兽撇撇嘴，看到大量火兽被杀，它无比郁闷。
因为这些火兽都是它的力量凝聚而出，平日里众多弟子杀戮，他可以控制力量均衡，但现在发疯的弟子太多，导致现在他气机有些虚弱，恐怕要休养一段时间才能缓过来。
“都疯了啊，至于吗？”
很快，剑峰一个弟子御剑飞来，俯视着镇关火兽，淡淡说道，“我出剑了。”
镇关火兽趴在地上，硕大的头颅如同小山丘一样，身上散发着阵阵恐怖的灵火，它的眼睛睁开如同铜铃，缓缓说道。
“出手吧。”
突然一道剑气化作长虹激射而出。
见此，镇关火兽庞大的身躯站了起来，向着洛凌空一爪子拍了过来。
下一瞬间。
镇关火兽直接被剑气切割成了两半！
秒杀！
那个剑修弟子脸上，出现了淡淡的微笑，“镇关火兽变弱了，还是我变强了？我觉得，是我变强了。”
说着，他直接踏入了第二层火渊。
等到那个剑修离开。
轰！
镇关火兽借火渊意志的力量，再次凝出一座庞大的身躯。
就在这时。
缥缈峰女子一袭白裙，玉足之下踩着璀璨的花朵，飘然降临。
她的纤纤玉手伸出，根本不给镇关火兽说话的机会，直接一道神华涌出。
镇关火兽还没有反应过来，身体之中就被一种无形力量所禁锢，继而化作了阵阵灵火花瓣。
它想反抗。
但是没用！
死！
缥缈峰女子嫣然一笑，玉足踩着火兽湮灭的身体，踏入了火渊第二层。
content_en:
Next.
Many Xuanhuang Realm geniuses were killing fire beasts indiscriminately on the first level of the Fire Abyss Secret Realm!
The inner disciples who were watching were extremely shocked.
The usually powerful fire beast has become extremely weak.
In one day, someone killed more than 30,000 fire beasts!
Many genius disciples went crazy!
The fire beasts on the first floor were killed so much that they had no time to solidify and appear.
The will of the fire abyss appeared in time to stop it, "The fire beasts have consumed too much, and the first layer of the fire abyss will no longer produce new fire beasts within three days!"
Many disciples were shocked.
Under the stimulation of Junior Sister Ji Fuyao, many geniuses became so completely crazy!
Indiscriminate killing!
At this time, top true disciples such as Fang Yan, Luo Lingkong and Liu Xuan stepped into the second level of the Fire Abyss!
Start breaking Ji Fuyao's record!
The Zhenguan fire beast at the entrance to the second floor curled its lips. It was extremely depressed when it saw a large number of fire beasts being killed.
Because these fire beasts are condensed from his power, he can control the balance of power when many disciples kill him on weekdays, but now there are too many crazy disciples, which makes his Qi a little weak now, and he may need to recuperate for a while before he can recover.
"They're all crazy, right?"
Soon, a disciple of Jianfeng flew over with a sword, looked down at the Zhenguan Fire Beast, and said lightly, "I drew my sword."
The Zhenguan Fire Beast was lying on the ground, its huge head was like a hill, and its body was exuding bursts of terrifying spiritual fire. Its eyes opened like copper bells, and it spoke slowly.
"Take action."
"Tsk!"
Suddenly a sword energy turned into a rainbow and shot out.
Seeing this, the huge body of the Zhenguan Fire Beast stood up and slapped Luo Lingkong with his paw.
The next moment.
The Zhenguan Fire Beast was directly cut in half by the sword energy!
Instant kill!
A faint smile appeared on the face of the sword cultivator, "Has the Zhenguan Fire Beast become weaker, or have I become stronger? I think it's me who has become stronger."
With that said, he stepped directly into the second level of the fire abyss.
Wait until the sword cultivator leaves.
boom!
The Zhenguan Fire Beast borrowed the power of the Fire Abyss' will to form a huge body again.
Just then.
The woman from Piaomiao Peak was dressed in a white dress, with bright flowers under her feet, and she floated down.
She stretched out her slender hand, and without giving the Zhenguan Fire Beast a chance to speak, a burst of divine energy poured out.
"Nima..."
Before the Zhenguan Fire Beast could react, its body was imprisoned by an invisible force, and then turned into bursts of spiritual spark petals.
It wants to resist.
But it's no use!
die!
The Piaomiao Peak woman smiled brightly, stepped on the annihilated body of the fire beast with her jade feet, and stepped into the second level of the fire abyss.
title_en: Chapter 15 Lu Xuan makes a brilliant appearance Chapter 16 Ji Fuyao makes a move in seconds
